live_decision_rule.formula: adaptive_threshold = 0.50 + min(uncertainty*0.5, 0.15); label = RESISTANT if probability >= adaptive_threshold
live_decision_rule.confidence: HIGH if uncertainty <= 0.05, MEDIUM if <= 0.15, else LOW
live_decision_rule.applies_to: All three deployed models; matches bactoai_pipeline.get_adaptive_threshold and get_confidence_level.
live_decision_rule.result: Identical confusion matrices and AUC to the fixed 0.50 rule on all 412 test isolates.
live_decision_rule.columns: validation_results/test_predictions_*.csv contain uncertainty, adaptive_threshold, live_pred_binary, live_label, confidence.
